claim: For the Parametric Map IOD, Values 3 and 4 of Image Type (0008,0008) are Defined Terms, which the standard makes extensible by implementers, not a closed Enumerated Value list. The dciodvfy warnings on AGGRESSIVENESS and AI therefore report a permitted extension.
value: FLOOR for 691 of 691 objects, two message classes, 458af26c2f99 and 4ad0c5efd0ef, both emitted at Warning
external_source: PS3.3 C.8.32.2, Table C.8.32-2, Image Type (0008,0008) Type 1: Value 3 shall be Image Flavor, common Defined Terms for which are specified in Section C.8.16.1.3; Value 4 shall be Derived Pixel Contrast, common Defined Terms for which are specified in Section C.8.16.1.4. PS3.3 C.8.16.1.3, Table C.8-129 and PS3.3 C.8.16.1.4, Table C.8-130, both: Additional Defined Terms are defined in the modality-specific Module and Macro definitions. PS3.5 3.10: The Value of a Data Element is a Defined Term when the Value of the Data Element may be one of an explicitly specified set of standard Values, and these Values may be extended by implementers.
status_note: This is the single highest leverage adjudication in the class: it decides FLOOR against NET for all 691 objects on two of the nine non patient name message classes. dciodvfy's own wording, unrecognized defined term, agrees that the position holds a Defined Term.
notes: PS3.5 3.10 also supplies the contrast that settles it: an Enumerated Value must be one of an explicitly specified set of standard Values and shall not be extended by implementers. Table C.8.32-2 does not use that word at this position.

claim: Rows (0028,0010) and Columns (0028,0011) are required in every conformant Parametric Map instance, so dicom-validator reporting them as unexpected cannot correspond to a violation of a stated requirement. General is not a module of the Parametric Map IOD.
value: FLOOR for 691 of 691 objects, two message classes: b8131f949456 Rows, 28878610d343 Columns
external_source: PS3.3 A.75.4, Parametric Map IOD Content Constraints: Either the Image Pixel Module or the Floating Point Image Pixel Module or the Double Floating Point Image Pixel Module is required, and only one of these shall be present. Rows and Columns are Type 1 in all three: Table C.7-11c, the Image Pixel Description Macro included by Table C.7-11a of the Image Pixel Module C.7.6.3; Table C.7.6.24-1; Table C.7.6.25-1. PS3.3 A.75.3, Table A.75-1 lists the modules of the Parametric Map IOD and contains no module named General.
status_note: Unlike C-PM-03 this pair is not in results/floor_set.csv: the highdicom built Parametric Map fixture does not trip it. It is adjudicated on the citation alone.
notes: General is the label dicom-validator gives its bucket of tags it could not attribute to any module of the recognised IOD, written at dicom_validator/validator/iod_validator.py in the call add_tag_errors with the literal string General. Which of the three pixel modules these objects carry, and why the tool did not attribute the tag to it, is not determined: the series were deleted after validation, and this project does not resolve a validator ambiguity by judgement.
